note: TEST CONTRACT, written BEFORE the implementation commit. Statuses are PLANNED/REQUIRED until the acceptance run in EVIDENCE_v1.0.5.json marks them observed. Never faked as PASS here.

controls.title: immediate semantic readiness (all 5 predicates true on first probe, 2 consecutive successes reached immediately) → PASS
transient psql failure(s) followed by full readiness within the bound → PASS
schemas progressively becoming available (auth, then storage, then extensions, then auth.uid()) followed by 2 consecutive full successes → PASS
one successful sample followed by a transient failure does NOT satisfy the 2-consecutive-success contract — must continue polling, not declare readiness early
persistent psql nonzero status until the deadline → FAIL, with diagnostic PSQL_NONZERO (never 'present natively')
persistent missing schema (auth/storage/extensions) until the deadline → FAIL, with diagnostic naming the missing schema(s)
persistent auth.uid() missing until the deadline → FAIL, with diagnostic AUTH_UID_MISSING
the poll loop is bounded by PLATFORM_READINESS_TIMEOUT_MS and cannot loop forever even if the injected probe sequence never resolves

after readiness has succeeded, a later actual phase failure (e.g. a deliberately-broken grant in a negative control) is NOT retried as if it were startup readiness — retry scope is limited to the readiness probe only

self_test_design.requirement: Deterministic no-Docker controls for READY-P1..P4 and READY-N1..N5, using an injected probe-sequence/clock abstraction rather than real multi-second waits, so the self-tests themselves are fast and never flaky.

acceptance_criteria.one_full_local_run: pnpm m2:pg:gate must exit 0 with OVERALL=PASS. All 9 disposable containers (MAIN + 8 negative phases) must reach PLATFORM_READINESS=PASS. Raw M2 Vitest exactly 1 file/4 tests/4 PASS/0 skipped. Migration proof mechanically green (62/62, terminal 0061). All 8 negative controls reach their INTENDED negative assertion (not a readiness failure). FINAL:LABELLED-LEFTOVER-COUNT=PASS (0). Port free after.
acceptance_criteria.no_iteration_by_weakening: If any negative phase still fails at the readiness stage locally, STOP — do not weaken the readiness predicate or increase timeouts past the authorized envelope to force a PASS.
